Most shower heads only come with one spray pattern, so when the water pressure feels thin, there's no way to adjust it. The flow you're stuck with is the flow you get, no matter what you're actually trying to rinse off.

This handheld shower head has eight spray modes plus two power wash settings, so you can switch to something stronger when you need it. Over fifty thousand people rate it 4.5 stars.
